verdict.rationale: Mistral documents its own confidence scores for extracted OCR content at page, block, or word granularity, so the scoring half of the story is product-native. Nothing shows the scores are calibrated or that they attach to structured annotation fields, and there is no built-in review path for low-confidence items; the community report of human review describes the user's own process, not a product feature. missing for 10: evidence of calibration, field-level confidence on structured annotations, a built-in human-in-the-loop review/routing workflow, independent corroboration of confidence-score usefulness.

support.subject: As a data engineer, extractions carry calibrated confidence scores with a human-in-the-loop review path for low-confidence fields

citations.quote: Confidence scores are available for extracted content at page, block, or word granularity through the `confidence_scores_granularity` parameter.
